curatedMovie.curiosityHook: What will a frustrated, unemployed teacher encounter after joining a scammer and his girlfriend in a blackmailing scheme?
curatedMovie.description: Out of work and running thin on options, a frustrated teacher teams up with an opportunistic scammer and his girlfriend to pull off a risky blackmail plot in Jean-Baptiste Andrea's crime comedy.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Fast-paced, suspenseful, and darkly comic, delivering engaged caper tension with moderate emotional weight.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Clocking in at an agile 86 minutes, it mixes fast-moving caper thrills with sharp comic suspense, offering an entertaining, high-energy crime ride that wastes no time.
